title: Customer report with no company, no contact, little data or lots of data
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work orders - View'.
  2. Work orders/inspections covering: no company; no contact person; a company with a name but no address/phone; a very long company name/address; and an inspection with no answered fields.
custom_steps:
1. With no company on the work order, confirm the Customer block is omitted rather than showing an empty frame; with no contact person, confirm the Contact row is omitted.
2. For a company with a name but no address or phone, confirm only its name shows, with no blank lines and no stray punctuation.
3. Confirm a very long company name or address wraps or is shortened rather than distorting the layout.
4. Confirm an inspection with no answered fields produces a report with zero counts rather than failing.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the work order has no company, the Customer block is omitted rather than showing an empty frame.
  • If there is no contact person, the Contact row is omitted.
  • A company with a name but no address or phone shows only its name, with no blank lines and no stray punctuation.
  • A very long company name or address wraps or is shortened rather than pushing the layout out of shape.
  • An inspection with no answered fields produces a report with zero counts rather than failing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9111 (S13 — Customer-facing inspection report); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S13; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N2: “If there is no contact person, the Contact row is omitted”

  • S13-E2: “A very long company name or address wraps or is shortened rather than pushing the layout out of shape”
  • S13-E3: “An inspection with no answered fields produces a report with zero counts rather than failing”
